items.title: Merge-aware fine-tuning stops quantization from erasing LoRA updates
items.why: Quantizing a merged LoRA model can wipe out up to 93% of what fine-tuning added - this rounds weights to the release format each step.

items.title: An ESP32 portrait tracks your face with eyes that actually follow you
items.why: A $10 board, a camera and two servos do real-time face tracking at 5fps - open-source, so you could build this in a weekend.

items.title: Saras lets Claude Code drive a real Raspberry Pi robot over MCP
items.why: An open-source MCP server wires a Pi, ESP32 and LiDAR together - a clean blueprint if you want Claude controlling your own hardware.

items.title: A simple breathing pattern blunted stress hormones before a mock interview
items.why: In a trial built around a mock video-panel pitch, box breathing cut heart rate, anxiety and stress hormones - try it in the waiting room.
items.source: PsyPost, on McAllister et al. (Comprehensive Psychoneuroendocrinology)

items.title: Ice baths ease soreness for days but can blunt your strength gains
items.why: A review pooling 3,210 people found cold immersion after lifting dulls hypertrophy - save it for cardio days, not after leg day.
items.source: ScienceAlert, on Berjisian et al. (Sports Medicine - Open)

items.title: Overtraining left mice with disrupted brain dopamine for two days
items.why: Daily double training sessions kept hippocampal dopamine abnormally high 48 hours later in mice - an argument for scheduled deload weeks.
items.source: ScienceDaily, on da Rocha et al. (Neuroscience)

items.title: Small-to-large merging turns tree DP into an O(n log n) trick
items.why: Keep the biggest child's structure and insert only the smaller ones into it - a real differentiator for subtree-merging problems on CF.

items.title: A freed memory pointer let guest VMs read host memory on AMD chips
items.why: A missed reset on nested VM restarts let a guest forge page-table mappings into host RAM - now patched, worth knowing how it worked.

items.title: APT's retry logic let attackers swap verified packages for fake ones
items.why: A malicious mirror could abuse ordinary HTTP retries to run attacker code as root - check your Acquire::Retries setting today.

items.title: io_uring skips syscalls by sharing two ring buffers with the kernel
items.why: One shared memory region replaces per-call context switches for reads and writes - reach for it next time a service is syscall-bound.
